name: Swatilekha Roy

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Swatilekha Roy is a poet based in Silchar, Assam. Her contributor biographies in Literary Vibes describe her as a bilingual writer and a lecturer at F. A. Degree College, with an interest in nature photography. Her poems there often find emotional tension in small, everyday scenes.

In “Turn back”, the riverbank becomes a place of companionship and possible return. The repeated invitations to let people go gradually open into a gesture of welcome towards those who come back lonely. Its spare lines leave the relationship unnamed, allowing distance, forgiveness and belonging to remain in conversation.
